shortDescription: Write entries to Windows event logs

options.name: category
options.description: A numeric task category associated with the category message file for the log source.

options.name: entry_type
options.description: Indicates the entry being written to the log is of a specific type.

options.name: event_id
options.description: The numeric event identifier for the entry. Value must be between 0 and 65535.

options.name: log
options.description: Name of the event log to write an entry to.

options.name: message
options.description: The message for the given log entry.

options.name: raw_data
options.description: Binary data associated with the log entry. Value must be a comma-separated array of 8-bit unsigned integers (0 to 255).

options.name: source
options.description: Name of the log source to indicate where the entry is from.
